results.title: Cash on delivery › Refunds for cash on delivery orders
results.text:
Refunds for cash on delivery orders are paid by bank transfer. Add your bank
details on the order page; the refund arrives in 5–7 business days after you add
them. Until then the refund shows "Awaiting bank details". Never share bank
details in chat.

results.title: Failed payments › Money debited but no order
results.text:
Sometimes a payment fails after your bank has debited the money: the money is
cut from your account, but the order is not placed. When this happens, no order
is created and nothing will ship. The money comes back
automatically within 5–7 business days (see "Automatic reversal").

results.title: Refund timing › Cash on delivery refunds wait for bank details
results.text:
A cash on delivery refund cannot be sent until you add your bank details on the
